items.headline: DRIVE ACROSS
items.title: Drive across Africa
items.body:
Take real jobs, deliver cargo, explore cities
and build your trucking career.

items.headline: DRIVE IN
items.title: Drive in convoy
items.body:
Team up with friends on the same route.
Shared roads, shared rewards.

items.headline: KEEP THE CITY
items.title: Keep the city moving
items.body:
Run a bus route, pick up passengers at every
stop and earn a fare for each one.
